# TapTicket

> TapTicket is a web app that scans restaurant and bar receipts with AI and lets a group split the bill: one person photographs the ticket, shares a link, and everyone claims their own items from their phone. No app install and no account needed for guests.

## Languages

The product is available in Spanish (default, https://tapticket.es) and English (https://tapticket.es/en).

## How it works

1. Take a photo of the receipt. AI reads every line item and its price.
2. Share a link. Friends join from their phones in seconds, with nothing to install.
3. Each person taps what they had, in real time. Partial splits are handled automatically.
4. See exactly who owes what and track payments until everyone is settled.

## Pages

- [Inicio (español)](https://tapticket.es): escanea tickets con IA y divide la cuenta entre amigos
- [Home (English)](https://tapticket.es/en): scan a receipt with AI and split the bill
- [Plans](https://tapticket.es/plans): pricing and plans
